== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Bow]] [[Icon]] is a powerful spiritual concept and [[Authority|authority]] that serves as the fundamental template for all archery. Rather than being a mere tool, it represents the collective essence of every archer who has ever existed. Those who tap into this icon do not simply act as archers but become fragments of a singular entity known as [[The Archer]]. This connection provides users with profound abilities, such as enhanced eyesight and a mysterious [[Authority|authority]] that bolsters their combat effectiveness. The icon can manifest visually, appearing as an image in the sky or providing a sense of eagerness to its wielder. It is often used to empower specialized weaponry, allowing for the creation of forged arrows that can bypass logic, defenses, and the stability of the physical world to strike targets directly. The [[Authority|authority]] associated with the [[Bow]] [[Icon]] can be inherited or borrowed, such as through legacies left in sacred texts.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Bow]] [[Icon]] functions as a source of support for its user, specifically backing the arrows used by [[Malice]]. During combat, [[Mercy]] perceives the [[Icon]] drawing closer to her, and she notices that [[Malice]]'s attacks carry echoes of its presence. The [[Icon]] eventually provides sight to the [[Netherworld Empress]] and makes a visible appearance in the sky. Despite this prominence, it is not the [[Icon]] closest to [[Mercy]].}}
